name: Special Forces
summary: At the Kurzen Compound, Sergeant Yohwa sets her sights on the colonel's elite troops. You enter the Stockpile cave to face the commandos and headshrinkers, then report to Lieutenant Doren.

sections.title: Striking the Stockpile
sections.body:
Sergeant Yohwa now targets the elite specialists at the Kurzen Compound. The Second Rebellion has weakened Kurzen's regular soldiers, and Yohwa knows many of his troops personally. She calls them skilled, loyal and cruel.

When they are not in the wilderness slaughtering rebel soldiers, the commandos and headshrinkers gather in the Stockpile cave at the back of the compound. To weaken Kurzen further, you enter and kill ten Kurzen Commandos and six Kurzen Headshrinkers.

sections.title: Reporting to Command
sections.body: After the fight, Sergeant Yohwa sends you to her commanding officer, Lieutenant Doren, at the Rebel Camp. He will want to hear your account firsthand.

faq.q: Who orders the attack on Kurzen's elite troops?
faq.answer: Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale orders the attack after you help thin Kurzen's regular infantry.

faq.q: Where are Kurzen's commandos and headshrinkers located?
faq.answer: Kurzen's commandos and headshrinkers gather in the Stockpile, a cave at the back of the Kurzen Compound. They also range into the wilderness to hunt rebels.

faq.q: To whom do you report after clearing the cave?
faq.answer: You give your firsthand report to Lieutenant Doren, the commanding officer at the Rebel Camp.

faq.q: What comes before this assault in the rebel campaign?
aliases: what quest comes before special forces
faq.answer: The Second Rebellion comes before this assault. You weakened Colonel Kurzen's regular troops across the compound.
